industry_problems: Pay-to-play models where agents buy visibility
Referral fees (25-40%) creating conflicts of interest
No quality gates allowing any licensed agent
Volume-based rankings rewarding quantity over quality

zillow.flaw: Prominence determined by advertising budget, not performance

homelight.flaw: Any licensed agent can join, no quality requirements

clever_real_estate.flaw: Pre-selects agents, limits consumer choice, referral fee conflict

fastexpert.flaw: Self-selection bias, agents choose to join

realtrends.flaw: Agents must apply and pay, ranks by volume not quality

topagentsranked.model: Agents can pay for higher rankings

top10lists_advantages.payment_influence: None - agents cannot pay for position
top10lists_advantages.data_verification: Third-party verified (MLS, reviews, press, licensing boards)
